title: routing_next_hop docstring names routing_has_path as a caller, but it calls routing_equal_cost_hops directly
detail: routing_next_hop's docstring lists routing_has_path as a caller, but routing_has_path calls routing_equal_cost_hops directly. Real routing_next_hop callers are tests only (flow_test.odin:82,86; ecmp_test.odin:88).
recommended_fix: Drop 'routing_has_path' from the parenthetical (e.g. 'callers: tests only') so the API-surface note stays accurate for anyone refactoring the convenience wrapper away.
